messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: REGIONAL_HEALTH_FAILOVER_TRIGGERED — elevated 5xx + p99 latency in eu-central routed through us-west. Policy: regional-failover, page on-call. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/region-health

maya: noticed. 5xx for embeddings up to ~12% in us-west, p99 at 2.4s. p50/p90 not terrible. Looks like a tail problem.

jonah: grabbing live traces. any recent model deploys or kernel flips?

ops-bot: Deploy detected: model-serving-1 v1.12 -> us-west-1 at 09:58 by deploy-bot. No rollback.

ashley: also saw an automated routing rebalance at 09:55 that shifted ~15% of EU traffic through us-west for cost optimization.

kevin: traffic graph: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/traffic-shift 020			us-west +18% at 09:55.

jonah: that timing lines up. likely regression in v1.12 interacting with increased kv cache pressure. maya, can you check cache hit ratios and kernel-fallback counts?

maya: cache hit ratio dropped from 98% to 86% on model-serving-1 in us-west. kernel_fallback_count increased ~5x. attaching quick logs: ```
[2026-04-23T09:58:12Z] kernel: fallback to slow-kernel for shard-7
[2026-04-23T09:59:01Z] kv-cache: miss for prefix=EU-AB-test
```

jonah: ok, mitigation plan: 1) trigger immediate slow failover to us-east for affected route-group, 2) add +2 instances to us-west pool to ease pressure, 3) suppress duplicate pages while mitigation active.

ashley: +1. also notify support of possible customer impact for EU-origin embedding requests.

kevin: creating incident board and temporary dashboard 'regional-failover-live' with per-region p99, 5xx, routing weights, autoscaler events. link in a sec.

kevin: dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/regional-failover-live (shared).

jonah: executing failover: `routing set-weight embeddings --group eu-embeddings --region us-east 0.95 --region us-west 0.05 --reason "auto-failover"`

ops-bot: Routing policy update accepted: change-id r-9872.

maya: scaling up us-west: `runtimes scale --pool model-serving-1 --region us-west-1 --count +2` 026. new nodes coming up.

kevin: note: suppressing duplicate pager windows for REGIONAL_HEALTH_FAILOVER_TRIGGERED while change in flight.

jonah: handoff: i'll lead mitigation. maya remain infra contact. kevin owns dashboards, ashley owns comms to support.

liz: can we estimate customer impact now? support stream shows 12 tickets tied to failover. I'll flag high-touch accounts.

maya: quick check: impacted customers mostly EU-marketplaces using high-concurrency embedding jobs. error rate per-customer varies 8-25%.

jonah: after failover and scale, error rate dropping to ~3.5% in the last 3m, p99 down to 1.1s. good sign. keep failover for 20 more mins while we validate.

ashley: for alert tuning: proposal: change REGIONAL_HEALTH_FAILOVER_TRIGGERED rule to require 5m sustained >10% 5xx OR p95 latency > 1.2s to avoid noise from transient routing blips. also add annotation linking runbook.

maya: current rule: ```yaml
- alert: REGIONAL_HEALTH_FAILOVER_TRIGGERED
  expr: (sum by(region)(increase(requests_total{status=~"5.."}[2m])) / sum by(region)(increase(requests_total[2m]))) > 0.10
  for: 1m
  labels: {severity: "page"}
```

maya: proposed: ```yaml
- alert: REGIONAL_HEALTH_FAILOVER_TRIGGERED
  expr: (sum by(region)(increase(requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by(region)(increase(requests_total[5m]))) > 0.10
    or (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region)) > 1.2)
  for: 5m
  labels: {severity: "page"}
  annotations: {runbook: "https://runbooks.redwood/internal/regional-failover"}
```

kevin: also suggest adding a suppression condition: if routing change of type failover is active for that route-group, suppress additional pages for 15m. avoids paging ops while mitigation ongoing.

jonah: agree. maya, can you open a hotfix PR in alerts repo with the above and tag me for review? We'll run the lints and apply if green.

maya: PR created: https://git.redwood/internal/alerts/pulls/244 026 titled 'regional-failover: increase window, add p95 condition, suppression note'. CI running.

ops-bot: CI: alerts repo checks passed.

jonah: merged and applied. `kubectl -n monitoring apply -f prom/rules/regional_health.yaml` 026. new rule active.

kevin: ran quick canary: synthetic traffic bursts on staging reduced duplicate pages by ~35% with new rule. added header note on dashboard: "Alert tuning active: 5m window; suppression if failover active".

ashley: comms: sent interim update to impacted customers and support. planning Slack customer threads + follow-up postmortem.

liz: on-call handoff — i'll take ownership in 90min. jonah please summarize timeline for postmortem.

jonah: timeline notes: 09:55 routing rebalance (+15% to us-west), 09:58 deploy v1.12 to us-west, 10:00 error spike starts, 10:05 failover + scale initiated, 10:10 errors decline, 10:30 monitoring. will capture in incident doc.

maya: follow-ups for post-incident: 1) root cause: investigate kernel fallback in v1.12; 2) add per-route failover alert and dashboard; 3) staging test for routing weight changes before automated rebalance; 4) long-term: capacity margin policy for cost-optimization windows.

kevin: opened PROD ticket for multi-region failover summary panel in Console: PROD-7414. includes grafana template + runbook links.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-03 026 severity S2. status MONITORING.

jonah: status update: stabilized, failover in place, alerts tuned. leaving monitoring mode until 10:30 then we'll either resolve or escalate. handing primary back to liz at 11:30 as planned.

liz: acknowledged. support notified of impacted customers. starting customer impact table in incident doc.

maya: final check: us-west 5xx at 2.9% now, p99 back to baseline. removing temporary scale-up will be in 30m if stable.

jonah: thanks all for fast coordination. good catch on the routing rebalance. we'll include mitigation timeline and alert tuning rationale in the postmortem.

ashley: quick note: consider adding an automated rollback trigger if kernel_fallback_count spikes > 100 within 10m for a rolling pool. I'll file a proposal.

kevin: added to follow-ups list in incident doc.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423-03 updated: status RESOLVED-PENDING-POSTMORTEM. next update in incident doc.

maya: thanks team. closing thread unless new pages. :white_check_mark:
